bookmarks.name: Top
bookmarks.note: No pauses: this show plays straight through and loops.

bookmarks.name: Halfway
bookmarks.note: A non-pausing bookmark: a jump target only.

bookmarks.name: Pre-show
bookmarks.note:
**Before we start.** The holding slate loops here until you press Continue.

- Say hello, check audio and the stream health.
- This is the *Pre-show* loop: one Continue leaves it at once.

bookmarks.name: Welcome
bookmarks.note:
**What JStream is.** A live-streaming and compositing engine written in Rust.

- Streams to YouTube or any RTMP target, records, and runs a virtual camera.
- One protocol: the app, keys, MIDI and AI agents all call the same actions.
- The title build is a *sequence*: cues reveal the lines, a lane swells the glow.

bookmarks.name: Scenes & keyframes
bookmarks.note:
**Scenes, items and keyframes.**

- A scene is a stack of items; each item places a source (camera, screen, browser, text).
- A *keyframe* is a saved pose of the same scene. Watch: Spotlight, Stack, Row.
- A Move glides every item from one pose to the next, no new scene needed.

bookmarks.name: 3D space
bookmarks.note:
**Every scene can be 3D.** Give it a camera and items get depth, tilt and turn.

- Lights light the cards; the sky is a light's backdrop (stars, nebula).
- The camera moves are keyframes too: Push in, Orbit, Rise, then back.
- A handheld wiggle on the camera keeps it alive.

bookmarks.name: Motion
bookmarks.note:
**Motion modifiers** animate any item with no keyframes at all.

- Wiggle (seeded noise), Oscillate (a wave), Drift (a steady rate).
- Impulse is a one-shot shake: the show fires it twice from an event cue.
- The same modifiers can follow audio, MIDI, live data or a channel.

bookmarks.name: Channels & sequences
bookmarks.note:
**Channels and sequences.**

- A channel is one number, 0 to 1, that many things can follow.
- The *Energy ramp* sequence moves it with a lane; the meter and orb follow.
- Sequences also fire cues: show or hide items, switch keyframes, set values.

bookmarks.name: Audio & MIDI
bookmarks.note:
**Audio and MIDI drive pictures.**

- Spectrum and waveform hear the program mix; the logo pulses with the level.
- Hit a pad or play keys: the MIDI visuals light up.
- The audio track brings desktop audio up for this chapter, with fades.
- This bookmark goes on by itself after 15 s if you don't press Continue.

bookmarks.name: Effects
bookmarks.note:
**Filters and effects**, on any item, scene or output.

- Hologram, scanlines, glow, rounded corners and shadows shown here.
- This bookmark doesn't pause: the show played straight into this chapter.

bookmarks.name: Agents & MCP
bookmarks.note:
**Built to be driven by an agent.** Everything goes through MCP.

- An agent sees the same state and calls the same actions as the UI.
- It can build scenes, run sequences, and run this show (`show.play`, `show.continue`).

bookmarks.name: Shows
bookmarks.note:
**Shows: this very timeline.**

- V1 program, V2+ overlays, K keyframes, S sequences, A audio.
- Yellow bookmarks pause (dashed) or play through (solid); violet loops hold.
- One Continue key or pad runs it all; jumps land the state playing would.
- We arrived through a stinger cut set on this clip.

bookmarks.name: Thanks
bookmarks.note:
**Thanks.** Questions?

- The Outro loop finishes its pass when you press Continue.
- At the end the show goes back to the Pre-show loop, ready to run again.
